<!-- Release: v0.12.4 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Keep the list steady when dragging songs upward in queues and manually ordered playlists
- Preserve smooth insertion-gap movement for single songs and multiple selections, including edge scrolling
- Update Android 16 verification to use the supported software renderer

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/55 - Stable viewport during upward song dragging
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/57 - Supported software rendering for Android 16 checks

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.12.4-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.
